job.question: Which retirement system's general investment consultant RFP requires respondents to currently provide non-discretionary general investment advice to at least 5 public pension plans larger than $5 billion and at least 2 public plans over $20 billion?
job.acceptance: TMRS or the full system name is sufficient; repeating thresholds is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an OCERS RFP, not an RFP for the retirement system in the question. Its minimum qualifications differ: five defined-benefit pension clients, including two public plans with at least $15 billion in assets. It does not require five public plans over $5 billion and two over $20 billion.
quotes: Requests for Proposal Issued August 2021 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Respondent must have at least five (5) defined benefit pension plan clients, of which two (2) are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each.
